name.ja: 1/144 ヴァルヴレイヴIV 火ノ輪

description.ja: • 流木野サキの愛機ヴァルヴレイヴIV。
description.en: • Saki Rukino's favorite machine Valvrave IV.

description.ja: • 肩のスピンドル・ナックルは脱着式で両腕への装備も可能。
description.en: • The shoulder spindles and knuckles are removable and can be worn on both arms.

description.ja: • スピンドル・ナックルの射出を再現する専用の台座が付属。
description.en: • Comes with a special pedestal that reproduces the ejection of the spindle and knuckle.

description.ja: • 腰背部に接続するマルチレッグ・スパインの特徴的な形状を再現。跳ね上げる可動機構も搭載。
description.en: • Reproduces the characteristic shape of the multi-legged spine that connects to the lower back. It also has a movable mechanism that flips it up.

description.ja: • マルチレッグ・スパインの形状に合わせた硬質残光のエフェクトパーツが付属。
description.en: • Includes hard afterglow effect parts that match the shape of the multi-leg spine.
